description: This file contains network utility functions for IP address handling, hostname resolution, and WebSocket security checks within a gateway context. It includes functions for selecting network interfaces, normalizing host headers, resolving client IPs, and validating WebSocket URLs, with specific focus on local, private, and trusted network addresses.

methods.name: pickPrimaryLanIPv4
methods.description: Selects the primary external IPv4 LAN IP address, preferring common interface names.

methods.name: normalizeHostHeader
methods.description: Normalizes a host header string by trimming and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: resolveHostName
methods.description: Resolves a hostname or IP string from a host header, handling brackets for IPv6.

methods.name: isLoopbackAddress
methods.description: Checks if an IP address is a loopback address.

methods.name: isPrivateOrLoopbackAddress
methods.description: Checks if an IP address belongs to a private or loopback range.

methods.name: resolveForwardedClientIp
methods.description: Resolves the client IP from forwarded headers, considering trusted proxies.

methods.name: isTrustedProxyAddress
methods.description: Determines if an IP address is within trusted proxy CIDRs.

methods.name: resolveClientIp
methods.description: Resolves the client IP from request parameters, considering trusted proxies and fallback options.

methods.name: resolveRequestClientIp
methods.description: Resolves client IP from an IncomingMessage object, with trusted proxy considerations.

methods.name: isLocalGatewayAddress
methods.description: Checks if an IP address is local to the gateway, including tailnet IPs.

methods.name: resolveGatewayBindHost
methods.description: Determines the appropriate gateway bind host based on mode and network availability.

methods.name: canBindToHost
methods.description: Tests if the server can bind to a specific host address.

methods.name: resolveGatewayListenHosts
methods.description: Resolves the list of addresses the gateway can listen on, including IPv6 loopback if available.

methods.name: isValidIPv4
methods.description: Validates if a string is a valid IPv4 address.

methods.name: isLoopbackHost
methods.description: Checks if a hostname or IP refers to the local machine.

methods.name: isLocalishHost
methods.description: Checks if a hostname or IP is local or within trusted domains (*.ts.net).

methods.name: isPrivateOrLoopbackHost
methods.description: Checks if a hostname or IP is private, loopback, or within trusted ranges, excluding certain IPv6 multicast and unspecified addresses.

methods.name: isSecureWebSocketUrl
methods.description: Determines if a WebSocket URL is secure, considering protocol, hostname, and optional private network override.
